I've successfully disabled the automatic quoting of original messages when replying in Thunderbird.

**What was done:**
1. Opened Thunderbird Settings via the hamburger menu
2. Navigated to Account Settings > Composition & Addressing
3. Unchecked the "Automatically quote the original message when replying" checkbox

**Result:**
Your replies will now start with a clean slate without automatically including or quoting the original message text. When you reply to emails, you'll have a blank composition window where you can type your response without any quoted text from the original message being included.
